estimate: P(MODIS present | VIIRS present, multiplicity), calibrated on 2012-2022 and applied unchanged after

validation.transfer: trained on Argentina 2019, tested on Canada 2023
validation.shape: the curve is region-invariant; the level depends on the matching unit

caveats: The target is a 0.01 deg co-location indicator, not a detection probability.
A 3x3 matching neighbourhood raises the level (0.288 to 0.684 in Canada 2023).
Landscape is not normalised away; the shape transfers, the level is calibrated per region.
No single correction factor: r falls from about 7.3 to 1.5 as multiplicity rises.
Geometric covariates (footprint, solar zenith) add almost nothing once multiplicity is known.
